data.name: Tempest Lost
data.detailed_description:
Tempest Lost is a top-down co-op adventure shooter from the Tempest Lost Universe. Play as a small commando squad that's tasked with discovering the truth behind a budding interstellar war. In Twin-Stick Shooter style, battle, plan, and survive a ride that leads to exciting locations. Select one of four specialized commandos on missions unknown, dispatched from a far outer-rim planet.

FIGHT TOGETHER: 
Up to 4 players can move out together and proceed through a variety of missions. Cover your teammates or throw grenades to save them, its best to proceed together. All players must reach the egress point to complete the mission. 

SPECIALIZED SOLDIERS: Select a soldier role and change your default loadout. Some soldiers are specialize in heavy weapons, some specialize in explosives, and some have unique abilities to deal with the common enemies seen throughout the story.

CUSTOMIZED LOADOUT: 
Customize your own weapon loadout in orbit above the planet. All soldiers have rifles and shotguns to choose from. Selecting a soldier class isn't restraining, you won't be restricted from heavy weapons should you come across some. Commandos are highly trained, and cross-capable with most weapons.  

STORY CHALLENGE MISSIONS: 
More narrow in scope, certain missions are a direct combat challenge. Some are difficult with two players, others are quite hard with four players. Which missions will you and your friends be able to finish? 

STORY SANDBOX MISSIONS: 
Beyond pure combat, sandbox missions let you explore, gather intel, and earn investigative rewards. Interview local residents, trade with vendors, and recruit local forces as you piece together the bigger picture.

For more Information and to follow the Story/Game, check out our website!

data.short_description: Tempest Lost is a top-down Co-op Adventure shooter. You play as one of 4 commandos tasked with discovering the truth behind many of the events in Tempest Lost. Join with up to 3 other friends for action packed story told in the Tempest Lost Universe.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K -or- AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 3 GB -or- AMD RX 580 4 GB (DX12)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible audio device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K -or- AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 SUPER -or- RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6600 (DX12)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible audio device
